verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for a cloud telephony service, so the axis applies. The pack documents only admin-console and app workflows. The one API item is the generic Workspace Admin Reports activities endpoint, which retrieves activity logs and is an adjacent building block, not a way to run Voice headlessly. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both returned 404, so there is no evidence of a Voice-specific API, CLI or headless mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
